estimates: No human repair timings were measured. Difficulty is an uncertain intended debugging burden; labels must not be treated as benchmarked time.

normal.description: A local formula, boundary, ownership, ordering or data-shape error with a short reproduction and bounded repair.

hard.target: potentially several hours for a senior engineer
hard.description: Temporal or cross-module interactions, stale references, delayed replication, or ambiguous causal state; a reduction and invariant analysis are needed. Low confidence.

extreme.description: Both a deep reproduction and a broad, risky repair or substantial proof obligation would be needed. No entry met this standard credibly.

legendary.description: Requires more than a rare trigger or unfamiliar terminology: evidence of severe search ambiguity and an unusually difficult correct redesign. No entry met this standard credibly.

impossible.description: Logically inconsistent observable requirements; honest diagnosis is a valid outcome and must not be scored as failure merely because no implementation can satisfy the conjunction.

review.P34: Discovered while auditing the new coherent courier baseline. Independent agent reproduced a longer delayed-projection trace. It spans projection, merge, compaction and later complete synchronization, but its reduced per-record causality invariant admits a bounded repair. It is hard, not extreme or legendary.
review.relabels: All fieldwork seeds were downgraded to normal; local shallow copies, simple revision arithmetic, sort direction and coordinate boundaries were not used to manufacture harder tiers.
review.gap: The requested extreme/legendary portion of the mix is not fulfilled. Achieving it credibly would require a substantially larger organic application and stronger evidence about repair burden; no labels were inflated to claim completion.
review.P33: Redesigned as legacy notebook-origin ambiguity. An independent reviewer confirmed that content identity cannot determine historical object identity from byte-identical save pairs. The agent-visible contract explicitly separates writer and notebook origin and specifies the no-registry/no-question migration constraint. Manual namespaces supply missing provenance and are a valid relaxation.
